## About
Wrench Recovery Automotive is a car repair and maintenance shop on Westerville Rd in Columbus. We want you to leave knowing what was done to your car and why.
We have a 5 star Google rating from 63 reviews. One reviewer calls Omar an honest, hard working mechanic, and another says we explained everything clearly without trying to overcharge.
Stop by or give us a call at (614) 816-5406. We are open Monday through Saturday.

## Services
- Auto repair: Repair and maintenance work for your car.
- Fleet work: One customer uses us as their go-to shop for anything their fleet needs.

Q: Do you take care of fleets?
A: Yes. One customer told us we are their go-to shop for anything their fleet needs.
